arxiv-2111-08750.title: Gravitational Wave Gastronomy
arxiv-2111-08750.creator: David I. Dunsky, Anish Ghoshal, Hitoshi Murayama, Yuki Sakakihara, Graham White
arxiv-2111-08750.description: Abstract The symmetry breaking of grand unified gauge groups in the early Universe often leaves behind relic topological defects such as cosmic strings, domain walls, or monopoles. For some symmetry breaking chains, hybrid defects can form where cosmic strings attach to domain walls or monopoles attach to strings.

arxiv-2305-00287.title: An Efficient Plane Extraction Approach for Bundle Adjustment on LiDAR Point clouds
arxiv-2305-00287.creator: Zheng Liu, Fu Zhang
arxiv-2305-00287.description: Abstract Bundle adjustment (BA) on LiDAR point clouds has been extensively investigated in recent years due to its ability to optimize multiple poses together, resulting in high accuracy and global consistency for point cloud. However, the accuracy and speed of LiDAR bundle adjustment depend on the quality of plane extraction, which provides point association for LiDAR BA.

arxiv-2307-00267.creator: Yuetian Mao, Chengcheng Wan, Yuze Jiang, Xiaodong Gu
arxiv-2307-00267.description: Abstract . Automatic query reformulation is a widely utilized technology for enriching user requirements and enhancing the outcomes of code search. It can be conceptualized as a machine translation task, wherein the objective is to rephrase a given query into a more comprehensive alternative.

arxiv-2308-05159.title: Strongly-Coupled Anisotropic Gauge Theories and Holography in 5D Einstien-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity
arxiv-2308-05159.creator: S. N. Sajadi, H. R. Safari
arxiv-2308-05159.description: Abstract In this paper we study uncharged, non-conformal and anisotropic systems with strong interactions using the gauge-gravity duality by considering Einstein-Quadratic-Axion-Dilaton action in five dimension. In fact we would like to gain insight into the influence of higher derivative gravity on the QCD system. At finite temperature, we obtain an anisotropic black brane solution to a 5D Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet-Axion-Dilaton system.

arxiv-2311-08204.creator: Lorenzo Paiola 1,2, Giorgio Grioli 1,2, Antonio Bicchi 1,2
arxiv-2311-08204.description: Abstract Characterizing the risk of operations is a fundamental requirement in robotics, and a crucial ingredient of safe planning. The problem is multifaceted, with multiple definitions arising in the vast recent literature fitting different application scenarios and leading to different computational approaches.

arxiv-2408-15508.title: EmoAttack: Utilizing Emotional Voice Conversion for Speech Backdoor Attacks on Deep Speech Classification Models
arxiv-2408-15508.creator: 1 st Wenhan Yao, 2 nd Zedong Xing, 3 rd Bicheng Xiong, 4 th Jia Liu, 5 th Yongqiang He, 6 th Weiping Wen
arxiv-2408-15508.description: Abstract Deep speech classification tasks, mainly including keyword spotting and speaker verification, play a crucial role in speech-based human-computer interaction. Recently, the security of these technologies has been demonstrated to be vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Explicitly speaking, speech samples are attacked by noisy disruption and component modification in present triggers.

arxiv-2505-21723.title: Are Statistical Methods Obsolete in the Era of Deep Learning? A Study of ODE Inverse Problems Thanks: S.Y. is partially supported by a National Science Foundation grant DMS-2318883. Thanks: S.K. is partially supported by an award from Harvard Data Science Initiative.
arxiv-2505-21723.creator: Skyler Wu, Department of Statistics, Stanford University
arxiv-2505-21723.description: Abstract In the era of AI, neural networks have become increasingly popular for modeling, inference, and prediction, largely due to their potential for universal approximation. With the proliferation of such deep learning models, a question arises: are leaner statistical methods still relevant?

europmc-pmc2848993.creator: Marsh SG, Albert ED, Bodmer WF, Bontrop RE, Dupont B, Erlich HA, Fernández-Viña M, Geraghty DE, Holdsworth R, Hurley CK, Lau M, Lee KW, Mach B, Maiers M, Mayr WR, Müller CR, Parham P, Petersdorf EW, Sasazuki T, Strominger JL, Svejgaard A, Terasaki PI, Tiercy JM, Trowsdale J.

pmc-10672721.title: Arrhythmias in Patients with Congenital Heart Disease: An Ongoing Morbidity
pmc-10672721.creator: Despoina Ntiloudi, Spyridon Rammos, Maria Karakosta, Alkistis Kalesi, Nearchos Kasinos, George Giannakoulas
pmc-10672721.description: With the aging of congenital heart disease (CHD) patients, the burden of arrhythmias is expanding. Atrial arrhythmias, especially intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia and atrial fibrillation, are the most prevalent forms of arrhythmia. Managing comorbidities, such as obesity, using pharmacotherapy, including antiarrhythmics and anticoagulants, and ablation therapy has become the cornerstone of arrhythmia management.

pmc-10673353.title: N6-Methyladenosine (m6A) Modification in Natural Immune Cell-Mediated Inflammatory Diseases
pmc-10673353.creator: Yan Teng, Jin Yi, Junnian Chen, Lu Yang
pmc-10673353.description: The post-transcriptional N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification of RNA influences stability, transport, and translation with implications for various physiological and pathological processes. Immune cell development, differentiation, and activation are also thought to be regulated by m6A and affect host defense against pathogens and inflammatory response with impacts on infectious, neoplastic, autoimmune, cardiovascular, hepatic, and osteal diseases.

pmc-11301822.title: Factors associated with total laryngectomy following organ‐preserving treatment of laryngeal SCC
pmc-11301822.creator: Mitchell T. Victor, Farhoud Faraji, Rohith Voora, Sandhya Kalavacherla, Loren K. Mell, Brent S. Rose, Theresa W. Guo
pmc-11301822.description: Objective(s)A subset of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (LSCC) patients undergoing larynx preserving treatment ultimately require total laryngectomy (TL) for oncologic or functional reasons. This study aims to identify TL risk factors in these patients.MethodsRetrospective cohort study using Veterans Affairs (VA) database. T1–T4 LSCC cases treated with primary radiotherapy (XRT) or chemoradiotherapy (CRT) were assessed for TL and recurrence.

pmc-11313704.title: Quinoa: A Promising Crop for Resolving the Bottleneck of Cultivation in Soils Affected by Multiple Environmental Abiotic Stresses
pmc-11313704.creator: Zahra Dehghanian, Mohammad Ahmadabadi, Behnam Asgari Lajayer, Vahideh Gougerdchi, Mohsen Hamedpour-Darabi, Nazila Bagheri, Ritika Sharma, Ramesh R. Vetukuri, Tess Astatkie, Bernard Dell
pmc-11313704.description: Quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd.) has gained worldwide recognition for its nutritional values, adaptability to diverse environments, and genetic diversity. This review explores the current understanding of quinoa tolerance to environmental stress, focusing on drought, salinity, heat, heavy metals, and UV-B radiation. Although drought and salinity have been extensively studied, other stress factors remain underexplored.

pmc-11439363.title: A Case Report of Invasive Klebsiella pneumoniae Liver Abscess Syndrome Treated with Ceftazidime-Avibactam in Combination with Meropenem
pmc-11439363.creator: Mengying Yang, Baogui Wang
pmc-11439363.description: IntroductionThe emergence of carbapenem-resistant hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae (CR-hvKP) presents a formidable challenge to public health and clinical medicine. This dual phenotype of hypervirulence and multi-drug resistance often complicates treatment options, leaving patients with limited antimicrobial regimens. Consequently, adverse clinical outcomes and high mortality rates are common.

pmc-11617761.title: SSB expression is associated with metabolic parameters of 18F-FDG PET/CT in lung adenocarcinoma and can improve diagnostic efficiency
pmc-11617761.creator: Zi-Yue Liu, Ling-Ling Yuan, Yan Gao, Yu Zhang, Yao-Hua Zhang, Yi Yang, Yu-Xuan Chen, Xu-Sheng Liu, Zhi-Jun Pei
pmc-11617761.description: PurposeThe study evaluates the expression and functional significance of the Small RNA Binding Exonuclease Protection Factor La (SSB) gene in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). By utilizing 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose (18F-FDG) positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) machines, we correlated SSB gene expression with PET/CT parameters, as well as its value in LUAD diagnosis.MethodsFifty-five patients with LUAD underwent 18F-FDG PET/CT imaging prior to pulmonary surgery.

pmc-11689861.title: THE GOOD, THE BAD, AND THE BALANCE: CHALLENGES AND OPPORTUNITIES IN USING TECHNOLOGY IN DEMENTIA CARE DYAD
pmc-11689861.creator: Kuan-Hua Chen, Lyndsey Miller, Allison Lindauer
pmc-11689861.description: Advances in modern technologies, including wearables, mobile or embedded devices and sensors, and AI provide researchers and clinicians with exciting opportunities for naturalistic, large-scale, long-term, and timely assessment and intervention. In dementia, the vast majority of research and interventions using technology have been focusing on individuals—either only the care recipient or their family care partners.

pmc-11731924.title: Antioxidant, anti-collagenase, and antibacterial activities of Fucus vesiculosus silver nanoparticles
pmc-11731924.creator: Evika S. Savitri, Annisa E. Rahmawaty, Eko B. Minarno
pmc-11731924.description: Fucus vesiculosus is an alga with high fucoxanthin, phlorotannin, fucoidan, sterol, and astaxanthin. The silver nanoparticles of F. vesiculosus (AgNPs-Fv) are expected to have high antioxidant, anti-collagenase, and antibacterial activities. The aim of this study was to characterize the distribution and size of AgNPs-Fv and determine their antioxidant, anti-collagenase, and antibacterial activities.

pmc-12452972.title: Visual Outcomes Following Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy in Acute Central Retinal Artery Occlusion Patients
pmc-12452972.creator: Somanus Thoongsuwan, Thanut Sirichayaporn, Nuttawut Rodanant, Nopasak Phasukkijwatana, Supalert Prakhunhungsit, Nida Wongchaisuwat, Chinnapat Montrisuksirikun, Adisak Trinavarat, Kusuma Chinaroonchai, Supathida Jiamsawad
pmc-12452972.description: PurposeTo evaluate the efficacy of a novel HBOT protocol, characterized by specific pressure levels and treatment duration in patients with CRAO patients presenting within 24 hours, compared to a non-HBOT cohort.Patients and methodsThis retrospective cohort study included patients diagnosed with CRAO presenting within 24 hours from October 2003 to March 2022.

pmc-12504590.title: Compare the safety and efficacy of integrated securement device versus suture securement for centrally inserted central venous catheters: a prospective cohort study
pmc-12504590.creator: Yilin Chen, Xianghua Chen, Xianghong Jin, Xufen Zeng, Xiuzhu Cao, Linfang Zhao
pmc-12504590.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The securement of centrally inserted central venous catheters is crucial for their safe use. However, a standardized approach to centrally inserted central venous catheters securement has not been established, and securement methods remain controversial.

pmc-13240819.title: Modulating hawthorn pectin properties: Effects of fruit storage and post-extraction enzymatic treatment
pmc-13240819.creator: Xueyan Wei, Mengxin Chen, Zhengtao Zhao, Kang Xu, Li Zhao, Xueping Liu, Dongxiao Sun-Waterhouse, Mengmeng Guo
pmc-13240819.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study investigated the effects of fruits storage time and an enzymatic treatment with amylase and amyloglucosidase post pectin extraction on the structural, physicochemical, emulsifying, gelling, antioxidant, α-amylase/pancreatic lipase inhibitory, and prebiotic properties of hawthorn pectin (HP). Increasing fruit storage duration decreased molecular weight (Mw), degree of methylesterification (DM), antioxidant, α-amylase inhibitory or pancreatic lipase inhibitory activities of HP, but increased its prebiotic potential on two Lactobacillus casei strains.

pmc-13304566.title: β-Cyclodextrin Inclusion Complexes of 20-Hydroxyecdysone Derivatives: Synthesis, NMR Characterization, and In Vitro/In Vivo Evaluation of Antioxidant, Hepatoprotective, and Antimicrobial Activities
pmc-13304566.creator: Borash Tuleuov, Aizhan Zeinuldina, Aidana Bazarkhankyzy, Aizhan Kozhanova, Bakhtiyar Temirgaziyev, Saniya Dyussekeyeva, Lyazzat Abulyaissova, Nurgul Askarova, Aliya Temirbekova, Zhanar Tekebayeva, Ardak Sapiyeva, Sergazy Adekenov
pmc-13304566.description: Background/Objectives: For the first time, water-soluble encapsulated forms of 20-hydroxyecdysone were synthesized as clathrate complexes with β-cyclodextrin. The derivatives included a ketoxime form (20-NOH), obtained by selective oximation of the C-6 carbonyl, and a triacetate form (3Ac-20E), obtained by regioselective acetylation of the C-2, C-3, and C-22 hydroxyl groups.

pmc-13364788.title: Is Preoperative Serum Bicarbonate an Undervalued Risk Factor in Cardiac Surgery?
pmc-13364788.creator: Wesley Chorney, John Hinchion
pmc-13364788.description: AbstractExisting risk stratification methods in cardiothoracic surgery do not use pre-operative bicarbonate levels. We investigate if these levels carry predictive value when compared with demographic, hematologic, and other renal function indicators. We used the MIMIC-IV database to identify 11,261 patients on the cardiothoracic surgery unit who underwent ICD-9 or ICD-10 coded cardiac procedures.
